source_class: Official NRL Finals Week 1 team list and official NRL.com player profiles
rule: Raw profile facts remain separate from MAYHEM inference. Unpublished fields are FIELD_NOT_PUBLISHED. Derived trends use only genuine exposed per-round rows; no causal explanation is inferred from statistics alone.

players.trend_note: Official exposed rows show Round 19 at hooker for 54 minutes, Round 20 from interchange for 44 minutes, and Round 27 at lock for 80 minutes.
